text:
Aisha Noor: Hi team  excited to join Redwood today! Laptop arrived. Quick items: 1) SSH to jumpbox fails with 'Permission denied (publickey)'; 2) where do I pick up a building badge if I swing by SF next week? 3) who is my onboarding buddy? Fun fact: I make chocolate chip cookies that never last the weekend.
Rohan Mehta: Welcome Aisha!! Im your buddy for the month, happy to help. Badge pickup at Lobby B (9-4). If remote, Priya can ship a sticker.
devops-raft: For SSH, ensure your public key is uploaded to GitLab and MDM enrollment is complete. Common commands:
`ls -la ~/.ssh`
`ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa`
`ssh -v aisha@jump.redwood.internal`
it-bot: Reminder: VPN and jumpbox require CompanyMDM enrollment before access.
mdm-bot: Enroll steps: install CompanyMDM, sign in with @redwood.com, enter emailed code. Policies take ~5-10 minutes. Reply "done" when finished.
Aisha Noor: Installing MDM now, adding my pubkey to GitLab. My timezone is GMT+5:30  will mostly do async. Any must-join meetings first week?
Rohan Mehta: No mandatory meetings. We'll do 1:1s week 1 and 2; I'll post notes and recordings. Also added you to #new-hires and #infra-intros.
Aisha Noor: Enrolled and retried SSH  still seeing permission denied. Sending `ssh -v` output to Rohan in DM. Thanks everyone for the quick responses! Also: cookies on my first in-person lunch if youre around :cookie:
